'''Janlan''' was a [[Near-Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] consortium operating in the [[Eschaton system/Legends|Eschaton system]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], members of the consortium agreed to a meeting with members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in order to provide the Alliance with material for the construction of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. However, Janlan betrayed both sides, notifying the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] of when and where the meeting was supposed to take place.<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>
